title: Herb Infused Turkish Shrimp Wrap
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Turkish dish featuring shrimp paste, leaf wrap steam, and a blend of herbs, perfect for kids and adults alike.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the shrimp paste, yogurt, parsley, dill, lemon juice, and olive oil until well combined.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Lay a large lettuce leaf flat on a clean surface and spoon about 1/4 cup of the shrimp mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining lettuce leaves and filling.
Place the wraps in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 8-10 minutes, or until the shrimp is cooked through.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
